Introduction to Machine Learning

Machine learning is a branch of artificial intelligence that enables computers to learn from data and improve their performance.

There are three main types of machine learning: supervised, unsupervised and reinforcement learning, and each of them solves a different kind of problem.

Example

from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
model = LinearRegression()  # this line creates a model that is used for the training of data
  • Supervised learning uses labelled data to train a model that can predict outcomes for new inputs.
